artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan mechanically anchoring the repo-tagged Sapience wrapup write at every implement-completion path, with bound enforcement, a visible zero-notes gap, and a stubbed test suite.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a change that must fire at every implement-completion in this codebase, prefer a standalone script invoked as a subprocess over a new skill-base.sh function: reconcile-task-status.sh (the deferred/deploy-gate-refusal completion path) sources only lib/common.sh and deploy-root-guard.sh, never skill-base.sh, and already reaches core behavior by sibling-script call (update-task-status.sh). A skill-base.sh function would require sourcing a multi-thousand-line lifecycle library into that script for one call, and is also harder to test because the suite then needs a sourcing fixture.
